title: Tetranuclear {LnIII}4 complexes possessing homometallic O-capped structural subunits: study of magnetic and photoluminescent properties

material_class.structural_family: tetranuclear O-capped butterfly Ln4 with two Ln3O subunits

synthesis.procedure: General procedure for 1–6: LnCl3·nH2O was added to a stirred solution of di-2-pyridyl ketone in methanol (20 mL). Sodium pivalate hydrate and triethylamine were added, and the mixture was stirred for 30 min at 60 °C, affording a clear colorless solution. The solution was evaporated to dryness, the residue redissolved in methanol and filtered, and the filtrate was allowed to evaporate slowly at room temperature. Colorless crystals suitable for X-ray diffraction formed after two weeks. For 1: (py)2CO (0.062 g, 0.336 mmol), NdCl3·6H2O (0.060 g, 0.168 mmol), NEt3 (0.4 mL, 2.869 mmol), NaPiv (0.072 g, 0.507 mmol).
synthesis.vessel_or_method: solution synthesis; rotary evaporation to dryness; slow evaporation of methanol filtrate
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: evaporated to dryness, redissolved in methanol, filtered; slow evaporation at room temperature gave colorless crystals after two weeks

properties.summary: Solid-state RT photoluminescence: ligand-centred emission at ~306 nm (λex 270 nm); Nd-centred emission at 517, 624 and 724 nm (λex 380 nm). DC magnetometry (1000 Oe, 2–200 K; M vs H up to 7 T) and AC susceptibility at 2 K (50 Hz–10 kHz, 0–2500 Oe) show no clear χ″ maximum, so no slow magnetic relaxation/SMM behaviour in the experimental window. CASSCF indicates fast ground-state QTM (kQTM 0.46 and 0.98 μB at Nd centres).

Computed χT shows weak TIP behaviour.

properties.summary: Ligand sensitizes Tb3+: solid-state emission at 493, 548, 586 and 622 nm (λex 360 nm; 5D4→7F6–3) plus ligand band ~306 nm and a 490 nm 5D4→7F6 feature (λex 270 nm). POLY_ANISO fit of DC data: Jtotal = −0.12/−0.14/−0.07 cm−1 (J1–J3), zJ = −0.002 cm−1; antiferromagnetic exchange/dipolar coupling. Exchange-coupled tunnel splitting 1.5×10−3 cm−1; QTM dominates and SMM behaviour is diminished. AC at 2 K shows no χ″ maximum, only a rise near 10 kHz.
